entities.summary: Cornelius Nepos (b. 99 BCE, Ostiglia) was a political leader or statesperson of the Classical era, an age of empires, philosophical inquiry, and foundational civilizations, active in Ostiglia. Known in the fields of journalists & chroniclers.
